summary.text: Bride Rose Sweeney is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Robert Dintaman.
She has represented District 16 in the Ohio House of Representatives since 2018, where she is the ranking member of the House Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bride Rose Sweeney was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree from John Carroll University in 2014.
Her career experience includes working as a legislative staffer and legislator.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she joined Ohio's Legislative Service Commission Fellowship after college and worked in the Ohio Senate, including as a senior advisor to the Minority Leader and a legislative aide to Senator Lou Gentile.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Sweeney said she was elected to the Ohio House in November 2018; her Ballotpedia profile lists her tenure as 2018 to the present, with her term ending in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Energy Committee, the House Insurance Committee and the House Finance Committee, on which she is the ranking member.
In the 2022 survey, she described herself as the lead Democratic sponsor of the bipartisan Fair School Funding Plan that became law on July 1, 2021.
